messages.subject: Correlation Matrix as input
parts:
Hello,
I know you can enter a covariance matrix as an input, but is there any ability to enter a correlation matrix and means/SD in as an input?

Thank you!

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Correlation Matrix as input
parts:
On 07/29/2015 05:50 AM, Joshua Curtiss wrote:
> Hello,
> I know you can enter a covariance matrix as an input, but is there any
> ability to enter a correlation matrix and means/SD in as an input?

Directly as arguments: no. But the getCov() function will take your
correlation matrix + SDs, and turn them into a covariance matrix.

So if 'R' is a correlation matrix, and 'SD' a vector of standard
deviations, then you can call the sem() function as follows:

fit <- sem(myModel, sample.cov = getCov(R, sds = R), sample.nobs = 100, ...)

See ?getCov for more information.

Yves.
